status: exploratory design fixed before new power results; not manuscript claims
scientific_question: Can the existing classifier maximum detect learnable nonlinear differences with matched population means and covariances, including heterogeneous departures across populations?
moments: Every population has zero mean, identity covariance, and all polynomial moments finite.

calibration.method: True log density ratio against N(0,I), fixed common random numbers; mixed scenario calibrates each departure separately against the same base, not the changing mixture.

statistics: Existing frozen AUC/maximum/permutation code; all original 12 candidate components and fixed L0-L7 sets; no new learner added.
comparators: maxmean, clx_mean, clx_cov, one-versus-rest maximum versions for mixed scenario; DISCO, MMD, MST, Schott and permutation Schott, mmd_max, KMD, Song-Chen S and SA

pilot_plan.first_smoke: 3 replications per cell, B=19; all settings retained regardless of outcome

learning_diagnostics: Save AUC for each learner and each population, not only population k; save xscr selected feature IDs and direction-specific observed AUCs in diagnostic reruns.
selection_policy: Do not alter models, strengths, dimensions or remove losing cells after inspecting new power. Keep old A-E and S1-S3 results. No guarantee MCA is best; all comparator outcomes retained.
